title: Console guided onboarding checklist: shell UI behind feature flag
creator: Dylan Brooks
project: Guided Onboarding + First Production Launch Checklist
description:
Add the initial Console UI “shell” for the Guided Onboarding Checklist (Hosted API, Phase 1), gated behind a feature flag. This ticket is intentionally UI-only: routing, basic rendering, placeholder steps, and empty/loading states.

Context
- This is the first incremental slice to unblock design iteration + downstream wiring (state model, validation, telemetry).
- The experience should be safe to ship behind a flag with minimal backend dependencies.

Scope / Requirements
1) Feature flag gating
- Gate all checklist UI behind a single flag (initial name: console_onboarding_checklist_v1).
- When flag is OFF, no checklist surfaces in Console.
- When flag is ON, checklist surfaces in the designated location(s) described below.

2) Placement + routing (shell only)
- Add a new “Onboarding” entry point in the Console navigation for eligible orgs/projects.
- Implement a route for the checklist view (proposed: /projects/:projectId/onboarding).
- Ensure route is not discoverable when flag is OFF (no nav item; direct navigation should show 404 or redirect to project overview).

3) Checklist component shell
- Render a checklist container with:
  - Page title + short intro copy (placeholder copy OK; final copy comes via DES-113).
  - List of placeholder steps (static list for now; no persistence required in this ticket).
  - Step states: “Not started” default; allow local-only UI interactions (expand/collapse) but do not mark completion in this ticket.
  - Each step includes a CTA slot (button/link) but links can be stubbed (“Coming soon”) unless we have stable doc URLs.

4) Empty / loading / error states
- Loading state when route mounts.
- Graceful “not eligible” state if project/org context missing (e.g., no project selected).
- Basic error boundary for unexpected render errors (log to console; no Sentry requirement here).

5) Accessibility + responsiveness (baseline)
- Keyboard navigable (tab order, focus visible) for step list.
- Reasonable layout for 1280px and down to 375px.

Non-goals (explicitly out of scope)
- Server-side checklist state persistence (ENG-23111).
- Validation signals (first request, streaming, etc.) (ENG-23113/23114/23115).
- Onboarding telemetry events (ENG-23112).
- Cohort targeting logic beyond the existence of the flag (ENG-23118).
- Final copy and final step ordering (DES-113 + UX spec).

Proposed placeholder steps (static)
- Create an API key
- Make your first request
- Try streaming responses
- View usage & latency dashboard
- Understand rate limits & quotas
- First production launch

Acceptance criteria
- With flag OFF:
  - No checklist nav entry point.
  - Direct access to /projects/:projectId/onboarding is blocked (404/redirect) and does not render checklist.
- With flag ON:
  - Checklist page renders with a static list of placeholder steps.
  - UI loads without backend state; no network calls required beyond existing project context.
  - Basic a11y checks pass: steps are reachable via keyboard; headings are semantic.
- Basic unit/UI test coverage added (smoke-level) for flag gating + route rendering.

Implementation notes
- Keep component boundaries aligned with future backend/state wiring:
  - <OnboardingChecklistPage /> owns routing + project context.
  - <ChecklistShell /> renders the list + step accordions.
  - <ChecklistStepRow /> renders title/description/CTA slot.
- Use existing feature flag helper/hook (same pattern as Rollouts gating).
- Copy should be kept in a single config object so we can later swap to server-driven step definitions.

QA plan
- Manual:
  - Verify nav/route gating with flag OFF vs ON.
  - Verify rendering on Chrome + Safari.
  - Verify keyboard navigation through step list and expand/collapse interaction.
- Automated:
  - Add a basic routing test (flagged/unflagged behavior).

Rollout plan
- Ship behind console_onboarding_checklist_v1 default OFF.
- After merge, coordinate with ENG-23118 for cohort targeting before beta exposure.
